quote: Gemini Pro became available to developers and enterprises on December 13, 2023, through Google AI Studio and Google Cloud's Vertex AI platform.
kind_note: Large language model / multimodal AI system
note: Gemini was officially announced on 2023-12-06. Developer access via Google AI Studio and Vertex AI began 2023-12-13. General consumer availability (rebrand of Bard) occurred 2024-02-08. Using 2023-12-13 as first public availability date when API access became available to developers.
